executed_checks.name: Affine axis-order, orientation, and sample-center versus corner arithmetic
executed_checks.purpose: Discriminates (row,column) input from (x,y) output, a negative x orientation, inverse mapping, and the chosen center/corner convention using a non-singular affine.
executed_checks.expected_behavior: Source (12,30) maps to world (94,-14), inverses to (12,30); sample index (0,0) center is (100,-20), upper-left corner is (100.1,-20.25); determinant is -0.1.
code_lines: # Data coordinates are (row, column); world coordinates are (x, y).
# Deliberately include a negative x direction to exercise orientation and ordering.
# determinant is nonzero; solve analytically for source coordinates
# A sample center index (0,0) differs from its top-left array corner (-.5,-.5).
scope_limits: Candidate-authored standard-library arithmetic only; no image, metadata, viewer, database, or application was exercised.
Checks this supplied affine and convention; does not establish viewer coordinate inversion, file-format mapping, physical calibration correctness, multiscale alignment, or application behavior.
